name: Facets Form Searchbox Widget
description: Adds a Facets widget that renders a facet's values as form checkboxes inside a Facets Form and provides a client-side searchbox to filter that checkbox list.
project_description: Facets Form Searchbox Widget adds one Facets widget plugin, SearchableFormCheckboxWidget (id 'facets_form_searchable_checkbox', class Drupal\facets_form_searchbox_widget\Plugin\facets\widget\SearchableFormCheckboxWidget), which extends the Facets Form module's CheckboxWidget and implements FacetsFormWidgetInterface so a facet can be presented as checkboxes inside a submitted Facets Form. On top of the checkbox list it renders a text input (a client-side searchbox), a 'No results found.' message, and 'Show more' / 'Show less' links, all wrapped in a fieldset carrying data-drupal-facets-form-ancestors, data-drupal-facet-id and data-soft-limit attributes. The attached library 'searchable_facets' (js/searchable-facets/scripts.js, css/searchable-facets.css) attaches a Drupal behavior that filters the checkbox rows as the visitor types (case-insensitive substring match on each row's .facet-item__value text, minimum 2 characters) and enforces a JavaScript 'soft limit' that hides rows beyond a configurable count behind the Show more link while always keeping checked rows visible. The widget adds a 'Soft limit' select to the facet's widget configuration form. Three Twig templates (facets-form-item, facets-item-list and facets-result-item, each with the --facets-form-searchable-checkbox suffix) plus hook_theme() / hook_theme_suggestions_alter() / hook_theme_suggestions_input_alter() in the .module supply the markup and theme suggestions. The module owns no routes, controllers, permissions, config objects, config schema, entities or Drush commands; the soft_limit setting is stored inside the facet entity's widget configuration by the Facets module. Depends on facets and facets_form.
